big_story.headline: Indian Shares Advance; Sensex Up 709 Points by 2:03 PM
paragraphs: Indian benchmark indices traded higher on Thursday, October 29. At 2:03 PM IST, the Sensex stood at 73,954.80, up 708.77 points (0.97%) from Wednesday's close; the Nifty 50 was 22,890.35, up 191.50 points (0.84%).

At 2:01 PM IST, Nifty Bank was 54,697.80, up 430.40 points (0.79%) from its October 28 close of 54,267.40. Moneycontrol's 2:03 PM market update reported broad advances, with Auto the exception among sector indices; FMCG, Media and PSU Bank were each up about 1%.

On October 28, the Federal Open Market Committee voted to maintain the federal funds target range at 3.75%-4%, according to the Federal Reserve. These are time-stamped intraday figures, not closing levels.

explains.title: What is Quantitative Easing?
paragraphs: Quantitative easing is a monetary policy where a central bank buys government bonds or other financial assets to inject liquidity directly into the economy.
By increasing the money supply, central banks aim to lower borrowing costs and encourage lending when standard interest rates are already near zero.

Indian skincare brand ISLAND Beauty, founded by Shirley Setia, has successfully raised ₹2.58 crore in funding from AJ VC. The startup aims to use the capital to build out its product offerings and expand its market presence.

The funding round highlights the growing investor appetite for consumer-facing beauty brands backed by prominent creators. With this new capital, the founders plan to strengthen their operational capabilities and scale up operations.

story_1.headline: Goyal Assures Farmers Protected in US Trade Deal
paragraphs: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India will gain a strong comparative advantage once the details of the proposed trade deal with the United States are officially released. Addressing concerns from domestic stakeholders, Goyal emphasized that the interests of Indian farmers and local industries will not be compromised under the agreement. He noted that the nation will celebrate the outcomes once the finalized terms are made public.

The trade agreement aims to deepen bilateral commercial ties between the two nations while safeguarding sensitive domestic sectors. Official discussions have focused on expanding market access without diluting domestic protections for core agricultural sectors.

story_2.headline: Vedanta Q2 Net Profit Zooms 78% to ₹6,202 Crore
paragraphs: Mining giant Vedanta reported a remarkable 78% year-on-year surge in net profit for the second quarter, reaching ₹6,202 crore. The strong profit expansion was driven by a robust 57% growth in operational revenue during the period.
Operational efficiencies and strong performance across key business verticals helped boost overall profitability despite broader commodity price volatility.

story_3.headline: PM Modi Warns Against Cyber Threats to Banking
paragraphs: Prime Minister Narendra Modi cautioned against economic warfare, stressing the urgent need to shield the national banking system from cyber terrorism. He highlighted that robust digital security measures are crucial to protecting vital financial networks from emerging global operational risks.

geopolitics.headline: India and Mexico Launch Talks for Preferential Trade Deal
paragraphs: India and Mexico have signed a framework and Terms of Reference to officially launch negotiations for a preferential trade agreement. The bilateral initiative aims to deepen trade ties and strengthen economic cooperation between the two nations. This move opens up Latin America's second-largest economy for Indian exporters looking to expand their global footprint.

While formal negotiations are now underway, both sides will need to finalize tariff reductions and clear regulatory hurdles across key sectors. For Indian enterprise, a preferential deal with Mexico provides a strategic foothold in North American trade corridors. Market observers will track the progress of these talks as both countries work toward a binding commerce agreement.

big_story.headline: Sapphire Foods Reports 21% YoY Jump in Q2 FY27 EBITDA to ₹1,286 Crore
big_story.text: Sapphire Foods reported its Q2 FY27 financial performance, highlighting a 21% year-on-year surge in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) to ₹1,286 crore. The operator of Yum! Brands outlets in India continues to expand its footprint amid steady consumer demand. This robust operational performance reflects resilience in India's quick-service restaurant industry despite inflationary pressure.

venture_vault.headline: Indian Indic AI Startups Raise $687 Million as Funding Concentrates
venture_vault.text: According to data from Tracxn, Indian startups building Indic AI models have collectively raised $687 million in venture capital, though funding remains tightly concentrated among a few top players. The surge underscores growing investor interest in building native language models tailored for India's diverse linguistic demographic. Expanding domestic AI capabilities is key to democratizing tech access across India.

venture_vault.headline: Simplismart Raises $14 Million at $100 Million Valuation
venture_vault.text: Bengaluru-based AI infrastructure startup Simplismart secured $14 million in funding from investors including NVIDIA and Dallas VC at a valuation of $100 million. The startup provides optimized enterprise tools for deploying artificial intelligence models efficiently. The strategic backing from global tech leaders highlights India's rising prominence as a hub for deep-tech software innovations.

geopolitics.headline: India and Mauritius Eye Expansion of Bilateral Trade Ties
geopolitics.text: India and Mauritius are seeking to further expand their bilateral trade and economic partnership across strategic sectors. The two nations are exploring enhanced market access and investment cooperation to deepen economic integration in the Western Indian Ocean region. For New Delhi, strengthening economic ties with Mauritius reinforces its SAGAR initiative and consolidates its position as a preferred partner.

geopolitics.headline: US Senator Marco Rubio Leads Strategic Trade Mission to India
geopolitics.text: US Senator Marco Rubio has arrived in India leading a high-level trade mission aimed at boosting economic and strategic cooperation between the two nations. The discussions focus on enhancing supply chain resilience, technology transfer, and bilateral commercial ties amid shifting global trade dynamics. The visit underscores Washington's continued push to deepen economic alignment with India in key sectors.
